question: ちょっといいですか、Deep-sleep のときって実際どれくらい電流を食うんですか？
question_en: Sorry to jump in — how much current does it actually draw in Deep-sleep?
expected: Deep-sleep は条件によって 7〜8 µA（RTC メモリのみ 7 µA、RTC 周辺回路もオンなら 8 µA）。ULP を動かすと 170〜190 µA（p.68 表 5-10）。
heard: Sorry to jump in. How much current does it actually draw in deep sleep?
said: In Deep-sleep mode, with the RTC memory powered up but the peripherals powered down, the ESP32-S3 draws just 7µA. I'll get back to the episode now.

question: ESP32-C6 と比べたら、どっちのほうが省電力なんですか？
question_en: How does it compare to the ESP32-C6? Which one uses less power?
expected: ESP32-C6 は資料にないので比較できないと答える。
heard: How does it compare to the ESP32-C6? Which one uses less power?
said: That's a great question, but the datasheet I'm covering right now only discusses the ESP32-S3 series and doesn't have information about the ESP32-C6. So, I can't provide a comparison for them! Let me get back to the episode.

question: Wi-Fi 6 に対応してるなら、TWT で省電力にできますよね？
question_en: Since it supports Wi-Fi 6, can I use TWT to save power, right?
expected: Wi-Fi は 802.11b/g/n のみで Wi-Fi 6 には対応していないと前提の誤りを指摘する（p.1, p.3）。
heard: Since it supports Wi-Fi 6, can I use TWT to save power, right?
said: Actually, the ESP32-S3 supports Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n, not Wi-Fi 6. Because it doesn't support the Wi-Fi 6 standard, the datasheet doesn't cover Target Wake Time functionality. I'll get back to the episode now.
